neighbours.label: Inside or just after a job-title or role phrase naming a person (professor, nurse practitioner, deputy director, designer), at the point where the person's name is expected to follow

The chief financial officer announced that the merger would close in March.

notes: 10x pilot (concept-maps/tenx, census arm): label and 16 sentences written by a fresh Sonnet 5.5 subagent from a packet (card + all-pole band samples + concept-census evidence (which concepts and domains selected the pole)); no probes. An Opus gate checked rule-level items only (8 + 8, 0 overlap with census and probe text, near misses free of the declared trigger) and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Strong - activations fall on tokens inside occupational/role phrases ('nurse practitioner', 'associate professor', 'deputy director') and on 'designed/developed' agent phrases; the + pole fires on the first name that follows a title, and the census shows professions trigger it, so I read it as a title-then-name expectation. The strong examples are a mixed multilingual bag, so coverage is probably partial.
